description: This is a shell script used for comparing the size of OpenWrt packages against upstream data, including functions for fetching package information, configuration comparison, and size difference calculations.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays help message extracted from script comments.

methods.name: package_size
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a package from a specified index, either installed or package size.

methods.name: compare_sizes
methods.description: Compares local and upstream package sizes, outputs differences and totals.
